clauses.reason: The command that executive branch departments and agencies close and excuse employees from duty on Monday, December 24, 2007 is limited by its own terms to that day, described as 'Monday, December 24, 2007, the day before Christmas Day', and was spent when that day ended. First end: 2007-12-24, inclusive; the actor is EO 13453 itself.

The authority of department and agency heads to keep offices open and employees on duty on December 24, 2007 qualifies the closing in section 1 and applies only to that date. First end: 2007-12-24, inclusive; the actor is EO 13453 itself.

The direction that Monday, December 24, 2007 be considered as falling within the scope of Executive Order 11582 and 5 U.S.C. 5546 and 6103(b) concerns that single day. First end: 2007-12-24, inclusive; the actor is EO 13453 itself.

research_rationale:
Section 1 closes executive branch departments and agencies and excuses employees on Monday, December 24, 2007, section 2 lets agency heads keep some offices open, and section 3 treats that day as within Executive Order 11582 and 5 U.S.C. 5546 and 6103(b) for pay and leave. Each of the three clauses is tied by its own terms to December 24, 2007. A search of held order texts for the number 13453 finds only the order itself, so no later order revokes or supersedes it. The end date is the closing day, recorded inclusive; the exclusive reading would place the end when the day begins.

savings.reason: No saving clause appears in the order. Pay and leave treatment for December 24, 2007 accrued on that day and is not a continuing command of the order.
